eligible_population: Adults aged 18+ with definite self-reported diabetes diagnosis response (DIQ010=1 or 2)
split: Stratified 60% train / 20% validation / 20% held-out test; random states 42 and 43
model_selection: Highest validation ROC-AUC; threshold selected on validation set by maximum F1; one final test evaluation
excluded: LBXGH HbA1c due to diagnostic leakage concern
survey weights/design variables from predictive features
limitations: Exploratory and unweighted classifier; not a national NHANES prevalence estimate
NHANES complex survey design not incorporated into model fitting/metrics
Single 2021–2023 cycle and no external validation
Self-reported diagnosed diabetes omits undiagnosed cases
Child participants excluded from classifier; model applies to adults only
Threshold optimized for F1 on validation data; different clinical costs imply a different threshold
